body.x: Samsung Electronics is showcasing the ES8000 at KES 2012, a smart TV that recognizes users and can be operated by the human voice and hand gestures. What’s more, this TV delivers programs that are optimized for the big screen, TV hardware with double the performance of previous models, and simple yet clear premium digital.

Samsung’s ES8000 has been praised by major media publications all over the world, and the device received a prize for innovation at CES 2012, the world’s largest customer electronics exhibition. Following Samsung Electronics’ 2009 release of a LED TV, the first in the world, they also became the first company to create a 3D LED TV in 2010 and a smart TV in 2011.

Now in 2012 they have delivered on the promise of a futuristic smart TV with the ES8000. The company announced that it is planning on continuing its seven-year streak as the leader of the world’s TV market in 2012.
